info.name: Stockbin API Admin
info.description:
Stockbin multi-tenant Sanctum API collection.

## Setup
1. `php artisan migrate:fresh --seed`
2. Start queue worker: `php artisan queue:work` (required for OTP emails)
3. Login with a seeded account (password `password`, PIN `1234` when pin_login is enabled):
   - `admin@stockbin.test` (admin)
   - `admin2@stockbin.test` (admin)
   - `salesman@stockbin.test` (salesman)
   - `manager@stockbin.test` (manager)
   Or use **Register** to create a new tenant + admin.
4. Bearer token is saved to `token` automatically on Login / Pin Login / Register
5. Set `base_url` to your app (local example: `http://localhost:8000`, default: `https://stockbin.app`)

## Roles
- `admin` — full access including `/users*` management
- `manager` — same business APIs as salesman (not user admin)
- `salesman` — same business APIs as manager (not user admin)

## Response shape
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Customers retrieved successfully.",
  "data": { },
  "errors": "No Errors"
}
```

Each endpoint returns its own meaningful `message`. API resource responses do **not** include `created_at` / `updated_at`.

Most business/validation errors return HTTP `200` with `success: false`. Missing/invalid Bearer token returns HTTP `401` with `errors: "Unauthenticated."`. Successful creates also return HTTP `200` (not 201).

**Binary exceptions (not JSON envelope):**
- Invoice PDF: `GET /api/sale-invoices/{id}/pdf` and `/pdf/stream` → `application/pdf`
- Report exports: `/api/reports/*/export/pdf` → `application/pdf`, `/export/excel` → `.xlsx`

## App versions
- `GET /api/app-versions` — public (no Bearer); global mobile version config
- Ordered by `app_version_code` descending; compare client build number to `app_version_code`
- `force_update` blocks outdated clients; `is_reviewer` flags app-store review mode
- Seeded by `AppVersionSeeder` (default row: code `1`, both flags `false`)

## Dashboard
- `GET /api/dashboard` — overview (default period `last_7_days`)
- Tab lists (max 5 items each): `/dashboard/low-stock`, `/dashboard/invoices`, `/dashboard/due-customers`, `/dashboard/expenses`
- Send `X-Timezone`

## Reports
- JSON: `/api/reports/sales|profit-loss|due|stock|expenses` (default period `last_7_days`)
- Exports: `/export/pdf` and `/export/excel` under each report (binary)
- Custom period max 120 days; send `X-Timezone`

## Timezone
Send `X-Timezone: Asia/Dhaka` (IANA name) from the mobile app.
Used by date-period filters on:
- `GET /api/dashboard` (and dashboard tab lists where applicable)
- Report JSON + export routes under `/api/reports/...`
- `GET /api/customers`
- `GET /api/customers/{customer_id}/payments`
- `GET /api/expenses`
- `GET /api/product-stock-history`
- `GET /api/sale-invoices/draft`
- `GET /api/sale-invoices`
- `GET /api/sale-returns`
- `GET /api/sale-wastages`

Missing/invalid header falls back to `UTC`. Timestamps are stored in UTC.

## Sale invoices
Mobile uses a **single** non-draft list + details API; drafts stay on dedicated draft endpoints for POS.
- List (non-draft): `GET /api/sale-invoices?period=last_100_records&filter=&search=&from_date=&to_date=`
- Show: `GET /api/sale-invoices/{sale_invoice_id}`
- PDF download: `GET /api/sale-invoices/{sale_invoice_id}/pdf`
- PDF stream: `GET /api/sale-invoices/{sale_invoice_id}/pdf/stream`
- Draft list: `GET /api/sale-invoices/draft`
- Draft show/update/complete/delete: `/api/sale-invoices/draft/{id}` …
- Optional `filter`: `due` | `paid` | `return` | `wastage` (ignored on draft list)
- Non-empty `search` ignores day/date filters, max 100

## Invoice PDF
- Details-based for `draft` / `completed` / `returned`
- Shop `invoice_type`: `standard` (A4) | `thermal` (receipt)
- Includes return/wastage qty badges and `return_amount` when present
- Binary PDF response (not JSON envelope); filename `Invoice-{invoice_no}.pdf`

## Sale returns vs wastages
Create via `POST /sale-invoices/{id}/returns` (restock and/or wastage).
- Restock-only (`total_restocked_qty > 0`, `total_wastage_qty = 0`): List/Show under **Sale Returns** (`/sale-returns`)
- Wastage-only (`total_wastage_qty > 0`, `total_restocked_qty = 0`): List/Show under **Sale Wastages** (`/sale-wastages`)
- Mixed restock+wastage: splits into separate restock + wastage records; each appears on the correct list
- Create response includes `companion_returns`, `return_value`, `due_adjustment`, `total_refund_amount` (list/show omit create-only fields)
- Partial return keeps `invoice_status = completed`; fully returned lines set `returned`
- Customer `total_paid` = payments − cash refunds; `total_due` = sum of invoice `due_amount`
Shared list query: `?period=last_100_records&search=&from_date=&to_date=` on `return_date`

## OTP Password Reset flow
1. **Forgot Password (Send OTP)** → `POST /api/auth/forgot-password`
2. Copy OTP from email / `storage/logs` (MAIL_MAILER=log) into `otp` variable (demo always `0000`)
3. **Verify OTP** → `POST /api/auth/verify-otp`
4. **Reset Password** → `POST /api/auth/reset-password`

Rules: OTP length 4 (current value always `0000`), expires in 10 minutes, max 5 failed verify attempts. Password is trimmed on reset.

Create endpoints save resource IDs into collection variables for chained requests.

## Error shape
Unauthenticated (HTTP 401):
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "message": null,
  "data": [],
  "errors": "Unauthenticated."
}
```

Validation / business errors (HTTP 200):
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "message": null,
  "data": [],
  "errors": "The email field is required."
}
```

item.name: App Versions
item.description: Mobile app version configuration. Public — no Bearer token. Global (not tenant-scoped). Seeded via `AppVersionSeeder` (default: `app_version_code=1`, `force_update=false`, `is_reviewer=false`).

request.description:
Returns all app version rows, ordered by `app_version_code` descending (latest first).

### Auth
Public — no `Authorization` header required.

### Response fields
| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| id | integer | Row id |
| app_version_code | integer | Minimum required Android/iOS build number (e.g. `1` from `1.0.0+1`) |
| force_update | boolean | When `true`, clients below `app_version_code` must block usage until update |
| is_reviewer | boolean | Reviewer / app-store review mode flag |
| is_maintenance | boolean | When `true`, app should show maintenance screen |
| maintenance_msg | string/null | Message to display during maintenance |

### Success (200)
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "App versions retrieved successfully.",
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "app_version_code": 1,
      "force_update": false,
      "is_reviewer": false,
      "is_maintenance": false,
      "maintenance_msg": null
    }
  ],
  "errors": "No Errors"
}
```

### Notes
- Not tenant-scoped (global config for all mobile clients)
- Seeded by `AppVersionSeeder` with a single default row
- `is_maintenance`: when `true`, app should show maintenance screen
- `maintenance_msg`: message to display during maintenance (nullable)

item.name: Auth
item.description:
Sanctum authentication + OTP password reset + PIN login + logout.

## Login / Register / Pin Login
- Register creates tenant + admin user and returns Bearer token
- Login returns Bearer token (auto-saved to `token`)
- Pin Login uses email + **exactly 4 digit** plain-text PIN (auto-saved to `token`)
- Passwords require **minimum 8 characters** (no mixed-case / numbers / symbols required)
- Password whitespace is preserved (not trimmed) on Register and Login

## Logout
- `POST /api/auth/logout` (Bearer required) — revokes only the current token

## PIN create/update
- Use `PUT /api/user` (User Profile) with `pin` + `pin_confirmation`
- PIN must be **exactly 4 digits** (numeric only)
- PIN is stored and returned as **plain text** (not hashed)
- Profile responses include both `pin` and `has_pin`

## Password Reset (OTP)
1. Forgot Password (Send OTP)
2. Verify OTP
3. Reset Password

Unknown or inactive emails return `success: false` on Forgot Password.

Public endpoints (except Logout) — no Bearer token required.

request.description:
Create a new tenant + first admin user. Returns a Sanctum token and role.

### Body
| Field | Type | Required |
|-------|------|----------|
| name | string | yes |
| email | string (unique) | yes |
| password | string (min 8) | yes |
| password_confirmation | string | yes |

### Notes
- Password requires **minimum 8 characters** only (no mixed letters/numbers/symbols rule)
- Password whitespace is preserved (not trimmed); email/name are trimmed

### Success (200)
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "token": "1|...",
    "role": "admin"
  },
  "errors": "No Errors"
}
```

Authenticate with email and password. Returns a Sanctum token, role, and shop settings.

### Notes
- Email is trimmed; password whitespace is preserved (not trimmed)
- Password must match exactly as stored (including spaces/tabs if used at registration)
- `shop_settings` is `null` when the tenant has no settings yet

### Success (200)
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "token": "1|...",
    "role": "admin",
    "shop_settings": {
      "id": 1,
      "tenant_id": 1,
      "shop_logo": null,
      "shop_name": "Stockbin Shop",
      "shop_email": "shop@example.com",
      "shop_phone": "01700000000",
      "shop_address": "Dhaka",
      "vat_percent": "15.00",
      "low_stock_threshold": 5,
      "currency_symbol": "৳",
      "invoice_type": "standard"
    }
  },
  "errors": "No Errors"
}
```

### Error (200)
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "data": [],
  "errors": "The email field is required."
}
```

Authenticate with email and PIN (**exactly 4 digits**). The user must have `pin_login` enabled in their profile. Returns a Sanctum token, role, and shop settings.

PIN is stored and compared as **plain text** (not hashed). `shop_settings` is `null` when the tenant has no settings yet.

Demo seed PIN: `1234`

### Body
| Field | Type | Required |
|-------|------|----------|
| email | string | yes |
| pin | string (exactly 4 digits) | yes |

### Success (200)
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "token": "1|...",
    "role": "admin",
    "shop_settings": {
      "id": 1,
      "tenant_id": 1,
      "shop_logo": null,
      "shop_name": "Stockbin Shop",
      "shop_email": "shop@example.com",
      "shop_phone": "01700000000",
      "shop_address": "Dhaka",
      "vat_percent": "15.00",
      "low_stock_threshold": 5,
      "currency_symbol": "৳",
      "invoice_type": "standard"
    }
  },
  "errors": "No Errors"
}
```

### Error (200)
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "data": [],
  "errors": "The pin field must be 4 digits."
}
```

Send a password-reset OTP email for an existing active user.

### Body
| Field | Type | Required |
|-------|------|----------|
| email | string | yes |

### Notes
- Email is trimmed
- Unknown email → `success: false` (`We could not find a user with that email address.`)
- Inactive user → `success: false` (`Your account is inactive.`)
- Active user → OTP stored + mail job queued (`0000` in current implementation)
- Requires queue worker: `php artisan queue:work`

### Success (200)
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Password reset OTP sent successfully.",
  "data": null,
  "errors": "No Errors"
}
```

### Error (200)
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "message": null,
  "data": [],
  "errors": "We could not find a user with that email address."
}
```

Verify the OTP before resetting the password. Sets `verified_at` on the OTP record.

### Body
| Field | Type | Required |
|-------|------|----------|
| email | string | yes |
| otp | string (length 4, current value `0000`) | yes |

### Notes
- Must call this **before** Reset Password
- Invalid OTP increases `attempts` (max **5**)
- Expired / too many attempts / invalid OTP → HTTP **200** with `success: false`

### Success (200)
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "OTP verified successfully.",
  "data": null,
  "errors": "No Errors"
}
```

### Error (200)
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "message": null,
  "data": [],
  "errors": "Invalid or expired OTP."
}
```

Reset password after successful OTP verification.

### Body
| Field | Type | Required |
|-------|------|----------|
| email | string | yes |
| otp | string (length 4) | yes |
| password | string (min 8) | yes |
| password_confirmation | string | yes |

### Notes
- OTP must already be **verified**
- Password / confirmation are **trimmed**
- Password requires **minimum 8 characters** only
- Updates user password
- Deletes all OTP rows for that email
- Revokes **all** Sanctum tokens for the user
- Then login again with the new password

### Success (200)
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Password reset successfully.",
  "data": null,
  "errors": "No Errors"
}
```

### Error (200)
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "message": null,
  "data": [],
  "errors": "Please verify the OTP before resetting your password."
}
```

Revokes the current Sanctum Bearer token only. Other device sessions remain signed in. Clears the collection `token` variable on success.

### Success (200)
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": null,
  "errors": "No Errors"
}
```

item.name: User Profile
item.description:
Authenticated user profile.

- Get Profile: `GET /api/user`
- Update Profile: `PUT /api/user`
- Supports name, email, password, pin, pin_login
- Response includes plain-text `pin` (exactly 4 digits when set) and boolean `has_pin`
- Password minimum length: **8 characters**

request.description:
Returns authenticated user profile.

PIN is returned as **plain text** (**exactly 4 digits** when set) together with `has_pin`.

### Success (200)
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "id": 1,
    "tenant_id": 1,
    "name": "Stockbin Admin",
    "email": "admin@stockbin.test",
    "role": "admin",
    "is_active": true,
    "pin_login": true,
    "pin": "1234",
    "has_pin": true
  },
  "errors": "No Errors"
}
```

Update authenticated user profile (including PIN and password).

### Endpoint
- `PUT /api/user`

### Body
| Field | Type | Required |
|-------|------|----------|
| name | string | no |
| email | string | no |
| password | string (min 8) | no |
| password_confirmation | string | yes if password sent |
| pin | string (exactly 4 digits) | no |
| pin_confirmation | string | yes if pin sent |
| pin_login | boolean | no |
| notification_id | string|null | no |
| geo_locations | string|null | no |
| ip_address | string|null | no |

### Notes
- Change password: `password` + `password_confirmation` (min 8 characters; trimmed; no complexity mix required)
- Create/change PIN: `pin` + `pin_confirmation` — **exactly 4 digits**, stored/returned as plain text
- `pin_login: true` requires an existing PIN, or set `pin` in the same request
- `notification_id`, `geo_locations`, and `ip_address` are write-only (not returned)
- Response includes both `pin` and `has_pin`

### Success (200)
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Profile updated successfully.",
  "data": {
    "id": 1,
    "tenant_id": 1,
    "name": "Stockbin Admin",
    "email": "admin@stockbin.test",
    "role": "admin",
    "is_active": true,
    "pin_login": true,
    "pin": "1234",
    "has_pin": true
  },
  "errors": "No Errors"
}
```

item.name: Users
item.description:
Admin-only user management (`auth:sanctum` + `active` + `admin`).

Roles: `admin` | `salesman` | `manager`. Seeded demo users use `@stockbin.test` emails with password `password`.

request.description:
List all users for the authenticated admin tenant (no query filters). Ordered by newest `created_at` first.

Admin-only. Includes `admin`, `salesman`, and `manager` roles. Response includes plain-text `pin` and `has_pin`.

Create admin, salesman, or manager for the authenticated admin's tenant.

### Body
| Field | Type | Required |
|-------|------|----------|
| name | string | yes |
| email | string (unique) | yes |
| password | string (min 8) | yes |
| password_confirmation | string | yes |
| role | `admin` \| `salesman` \| `manager` | yes |
| is_active | boolean | no |

### Notes
- Password requires **minimum 8 characters** only
- Response includes `pin` (usually `null`) and `has_pin`
- HTTP status is `200` on success
- Use a non-seeded email (seeded: `admin@`, `admin2@`, `salesman@`, `manager@stockbin.test`)

Create a `manager` user for the authenticated admin's tenant.

Same body contract as **Create User**. `role` must be `manager`.

### Notes
- Managers share business APIs with salesmen; only `/users*` requires `admin`
- Response includes `pin` (usually `null`) and `has_pin`
Show a user from the same tenant.

Update user name/email/role/password.

### Body
| Field | Type | Required |
|-------|------|----------|
| name | string | no |
| email | string (unique) | no |
| role | `admin` \| `salesman` \| `manager` | no |
| password | string (min 8) | no |
| password_confirmation | string | required with password |

Password is optional. When sent, it requires **minimum 8 characters**. Cannot demote/remove the last active admin.

Response includes plain-text `pin` and `has_pin`.

Activate or deactivate a user.

Deactivate revokes existing Sanctum tokens. Cannot deactivate yourself or the last active admin.

Delete a user from the same tenant.

Cannot delete yourself or the last active admin.

request.description:
List tenant expenses as a plain data array (no pagination).

### Search mode
- `search` matches `title` OR `note` only (not category name)
- A non-empty search ignores `period`, `expense_category_id`, `from_date`, and `to_date`
- Returns up to 100 matches, newest first

### Filter mode
Used when search is empty.
- `last_100_records` (default; latest 100 records, no date window)
- `last_30_days` (today + previous 29 calendar days)
- `last_60_days` (today + previous 59 calendar days)
- `last_90_days` (today + previous 89 calendar days)
- `custom` (inclusive `from_date` through `to_date`, max 120 days)
- Optional `expense_category_id` (or `category_id`)

### Timezone
Send header `X-Timezone` with an IANA name (example: `Asia/Dhaka`). Missing/invalid → `UTC`.
Required: `expense_category_id`, `title`, `amount` (minimum 0.01), and `expense_date`. Optional: `note`. The expense category must belong to the authenticated tenant.
Partial update. Accepted fields: `expense_category_id`, `title`, `amount` (minimum 0.01), `expense_date`, and `note`.
Deletes the tenant expense.

`product_code` is immutable and must not be sent. Partial updates allowed. category_id must belong to tenant.
`product_code` is immutable and must not be sent. Use multipart when uploading `product_image`.

item.name: Product Stocks
item.description:

| note | string | no |

item.name: Sale Wastages
item.description:
List + Show wastage-only sale returns (`total_wastage_qty > 0` and `total_restocked_qty = 0`). Pure restock appears on Sale Returns. Mixed create requests are split by the backend (see Return Sale Invoice).

### List query
`GET /sale-wastages?period=last_100_records&search=&from_date=&to_date=`
- period: last_100_records | last_30_days | last_60_days | last_90_days | custom (max 120 days) on return_date
- search: return_no / invoice_no / customer name / phone; ignores day/date filters; max 100
- no sort/order — always newest created_at first

### Show
`GET /sale-wastages/{sale_wastage_id}` — full header + items with nested product (product_code, product_name, category_name, product_image, unit, color, size, weight); same wastage-only scope

Create via Sale Invoices → Return Sale Invoice with `wastage_qty` (`restocked_qty = 0` for pure wastage).

header.description: IANA timezone from device (e.g. Asia/Dhaka). Used for last_30_days / last_60_days / last_90_days / custom date boundaries.

query.description: last_100_records | last_30_days | last_60_days | last_90_days | custom (default: last_100_records). Filters by return_date
Search by return_no, invoice_no, customer_name, or customer_phone. When non-empty, period/date are ignored and up to 100 newest matches are returned
Required when period=custom (YYYY-MM-DD)
Required when period=custom (YYYY-MM-DD). Max 120 days from from_date
